howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 10:30 AM PDT 21 August 2026 Today Tonight and Saturday. Wind light increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots early this afternoon then becoming northerly outflow 5 to 15 near midnight. Wind becoming southerly inflow 10 to 20 Saturday morning. Showers overnight and Saturday. Risk of thunderstorms Saturday afternoon and evening.
